plain: Showing scorn for someone or something.

webster.text: Manifesting or expressing contempt or disdain; scornful; as contemptuous language or manner; a contemptuous opinion.

example.quote: Was it not in the contemplation of this state, when contemptuous proceedings were expected, to recur to something of this kind ?
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 16, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
